posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
Powerhound_2000:

It also stuck out to me as it's the only time we see Biomancer in card art that before the VotM release.

This could be for a few reasons (all are speculative and not to be taken as fact):

  1. Adam had more cool/important scenes he wanted to draw and just never found good spots for Biomancer in the coming expansions after initial release

  2. They were not sure for a long time where and how to impliment the character (Vengence? Mini nemesis card somewhere? Full Villain deck? ect.) and so the character was in creative game limbo for a bit, reflected in an art absence.

  3. Biomancer really isn't a major villain like the others even with a full apperance in VotM. Maybe he only has one major story/apperance outside of his ties with Scholar. Scholar never had his own book or series as far as I know, so his main nemesis probably didn't get a lot of screen time as well. You could pair this with #1 nicely

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
I found it a bit disappointing that even with the great "two speeds" title we didn't get insight into her relationship beyond the logistics and scheduling.

Wanted to know things like, when they do get time together, say a night out at a restaraunt, how does she switch to slowing down and focusing on her spouse?  Is that a constant struggle for her, does she get distracted mid conversation by something mundane that reminds her of some problem she is working on?

I married a wonderful woman who is brilliant and always thinking about something, and so I relate to that struggle.  Since Tachyon has trained herself to deal with the slowness of the rest of the world by working inside her head at her own pace, how hard is it to undo that and give undivided attention to another person for a decent period of time?

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked: Also, I love that Tachyon is into stage magic, I'm a huge stage magic fan myself, so I love that connection.  Even have a stage magician character I made a custom deck of.  I imagine they would get along.
